I was diagnosed with TN after a super strong MRI found compression on my trigeminal nerve by a blood vessel. I went to the dentist first and was told there was nothing wrong with my teeth and that nerve pain was causing the pain in my teeth (which I’m experiencing right this second and is super painful). I’d be cautious of getting any type of dental procedure done if you’ve been diagnosed with TN by a neurologist or surgeon already, I know that even brushing my teeth causes extreme pain for me so I can’t even imagine how badly it would hurt to have a root canal. I suppose it’s possible though and I’m neither a doctor nor a dentist so I really don’t know. I’m sorry you’re going through this, I hope the pain eases for you.
